title: Short exact comparison complexes for external cup in the left coefficient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals. Let $S=(F\to E\to Q)$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. For $M\in\{F,E,Q\}$ let $T_M=\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(f,g,M,G)$ and $P_M=\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_1^*M\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ as in [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain] and [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. There exist normalized cochain maps $d_M:T_M\to P_M$ (the normalization predicate of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]), short exact sequences $A,B$ of integer cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces, and a short-complex morphism $\phi:A\to B$. The terms of $A_2,A_3,B_2,B_3$ in negative degrees are zero. For every natural $n$ there are isomorphisms $a_j:H^n(A_j)\cong H^n(T_{M_j})$ and $b_j:H^n(B_j)\cong H^n(P_{M_j})$, where $(M_1,M_2,M_3)=(F,E,Q)$, satisfying $H^n(\phi_j)\,;\,b_j=a_j\,;\,H^n(d_{M_j})$ for $j=1,2,3$. No specified comparison cochain maps, five-term rows, connecting morphisms, or invertibility hypotheses are inputs or conclusions.

proof.text: Obtain normalized d1,d2,d3 separately from picardExternalCupCochain_exists. Apply the explicit Cech exactness theorem to S to obtain short exactness of A=S.map T and B=S.map P.

Obtain the natural transformation theta and its single-coefficient comparison property. Define phi=S.mapNatTrans theta; the naturality squares give the short-complex morphism. In each n apply its comparison property to S.X1,S.X2,S.X3 and the normalized maps, then assemble the six isomorphisms and the three equations.

Prove extension terms vanish in negative degree from Mathlib isZero_extend_X and the nonnegativity of natural numbers. For a tensor-total negative degree, use mapBifunctor.hom_ext: every summand p+q=n has a negative factor and is zero because tensorLeft and tensorRight preserve zero objects. Hence the identity of that total term is zero. Apply these elementary calculations to the middle and quotient coefficients of A and B.

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternalCup_left_comparison_complexes
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
 :
    ∃ (d1 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G))
      (d2 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₂ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₂ G))
      (d3 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₃ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₃ G)),
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₁ G d1 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₂ G d2 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₃ G d3 ∧
      ∃ (A B : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℤ))
        (hA : A.ShortExact) (hB : B.ShortExact) (φ : A ⟶ B),
        (∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 →
          IsZero (A.X₂.X p) ∧ IsZero (A.X₃.X p) ∧
          IsZero (B.X₂.X p) ∧ IsZero (B.X₃.X p)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          ∃ (a1 : A.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (a2 : A.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₂ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (a3 : A.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₃ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (b1 : B.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G)).homology (n : ℤ))
            (b2 : B.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₂ G)).homology (n : ℤ))
            (b3 : B.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₃ G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₁ (n : ℤ) ≫ b1.hom =
              a1.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d1 (n : ℤ) ∧
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₂ (n : ℤ) ≫ b2.hom =
              a2.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d2 (n : ℤ) ∧
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₃ (n : ℤ) ≫ b3.hom =
              a3.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d3 (n : ℤ)
